title: 机械防护知识自测

points.K8: 物理屏障就是防护装置
points.K9: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏
points.K10: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带透明防护罩的设备旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a machine with a clear protective cover and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天用十道题，认识机械防护。

shots.scene: 一行图标：齿轮、皮带轮、防护罩、锁
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a gear, a belt pulley, a protective cover and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 转动的部件，要用防护罩隔开。

shots.scene: 车间里一台风机，皮带罩放在地上，皮带裸露转动
shots.prompt_en: In a workshop, a fan runs with its belt exposed; the yellow belt cover lies on the floor beside it.
shots.narration: 车间的风机，皮带罩拆下没装回。

shots.scene: 阿杰弯腰伸手想去捡风机旁的螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends down and reaches toward a screw near the running belt.
shots.narration: 阿杰伸手去捡风机边的螺丝。

shots.scene: 小研一把拉住他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly pulls the young male student back by the arm.
shots.narration: 小研一把拉住他：皮带还在转！

shots.scene: 老李赶来，看着拆下的罩子摇头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer arrives and shakes his head at the removed cover.
shots.narration: 老李说：咱们把机械防护好好学一遍。

shots.scene: 皮带轮、齿轮和飞出碎片三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a pulley with a hand nearby, two meshing gears, and a flying fragment toward an eye. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：运动部件会造成哪些伤害？

shots.scene: 手指被挤压的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of fingers being squeezed between two parts. No people.
shots.narration: 挤压手指和手，

shots.scene: 两个齿轮之间的咬入点闪红
shots.prompt_en: The nip point between two meshing gears flashes red. No people.
shots.narration: 身体被卷进运动部件之间，

shots.scene: 碎片飞向眼睛
shots.prompt_en: A small fragment flies toward an eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 飞出物伤眼，答案D以上都是。

shots.scene: 老李给阿杰和小研讲解设备防护罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer explains a machine's protective cover to the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 第二题：防护装置要培训什么？

shots.scene: 防护罩和问号、灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: A protective cover icon with a question mark and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么用，为什么必须用，

shots.scene: 防护罩被打开，旁边锁和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A protective cover shown open, with a padlock icon and a clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 什么时候才允许拆，

shots.scene: 扳手交给有权限的人员的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench handed only to a person with a badge. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么拆、谁能拆，答案D都要。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：固定罩、警示带、联锁门、可调罩
shots.prompt_en: Four cards: a fixed cover, a striped barrier tape, an interlocked door and an adjustable cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：哪个不是机械防护装置？

shots.scene: 警示带卡片打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The striped barrier tape card is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，隔离警示带。

shots.scene: 老李准备打开风机的防护罩维修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer prepares to open the protective cover of the fan for repair.
shots.narration: 第四题：拆罩维修前先做什么？

shots.scene: 警示带、提示牌、广播三个图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of barrier tape, a caution sign and a speaker, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 拉警示带、挂提示、告诉别人，都不够。

shots.scene: 开关上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The power switch is locked with a padlock and a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，上锁挂牌，隔离能量。

shots.scene: 四个防护图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four guard icons in a row: a bolted fixed cover, a door with a switch, a sliding adjustable cover and a spring cover that moves with the work. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：常见的防护装置有几类？

shots.scene: 固定罩用螺丝拧紧
shots.prompt_en: A fixed cover held by screws that need a tool to open. No people.
shots.narration: 固定式：要用工具才能拆。

shots.scene: 联锁门一开，机器停止
shots.prompt_en: An interlocked door opens and the machine stops at once. No people.
shots.narration: 联锁式：门一开，机器就停。

shots.scene: 可调罩和随工件移动的自调罩
shots.prompt_en: An adjustable cover set by hand beside a self-adjusting cover that lifts with the workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 可调式手动调整，自调式随工件动。

shots.scene: 四个防护图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All four guard icons get green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，四类。

shots.scene: 坚固的金属防护罩
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy metal protective cover on a machine. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：防护装置该是什么样？

shots.scene: 罩子用螺栓牢牢固定在机身上
shots.prompt_en: The cover is bolted firmly to the machine frame. No people.
shots.narration: 结实，牢牢固定在机器上，

shots.scene: 罩子把转动部件全部包住
shots.prompt_en: The cover completely encloses all moving parts. No people.
shots.narration: 完全罩住运动部件，答案D都要。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：开口、随手拆、新危险、易碎
shots.prompt_en: Four cards: a cover with a big opening, a cover easily lifted off, a warning triangle and a cracked cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：防护装置必须做到什么？

shots.scene: 罩子边缘锋利划手的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sharp cover edge cutting a hand, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，不得产生新的危害。

shots.scene: 大开口、易拆、易碎三张卡片打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The big opening, easy removal and cracked cover cards are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 留大口子、随手可拆、一碰就碎，都不行。

shots.section_title: 物理屏障就是防护装置
shots.scene: 人和转动部件之间出现一道透明墙
shots.prompt_en: A clear wall appears between a person icon and a rotating part. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：谁给运动部件提供物理屏障？
overlay: 物理屏障就是防护装置

shots.section_title: 物理屏障就是防护装置
shots.scene: 制度书、操作手册打叉，防护罩打勾
shots.prompt_en: A rule book and a manual are crossed out, while a protective cover gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不是管理或操作控制，答案D防护装置。

shots.section_title: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏
shots.scene: 机械事故现场图标：缺失的防护罩
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a machine with its guard missing and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：机械事故的主要原因？
overlay: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏

shots.section_title: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏
shots.scene: 防护罩缺失卡片亮红
shots.prompt_en: A card showing a missing guard glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，防护装置缺失或损坏。

shots.section_title: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏
shots.scene: 检查表和扫帚图标，没有亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection checklist icon and a broom icon stay dim. No people.
shots.narration: 其余选项：缺检查维护、现场差。

shots.section_title: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险
shots.scene: 欣欣站在防护罩前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a protective cover on a machine.
shots.narration: 第十题：机械防护的目的是什么？
overlay: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险

shots.section_title: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险
shots.scene: 防止机器损坏的卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: A card about preventing machine breakdown is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是为了保护机器不坏，

shots.section_title: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险
shots.scene: 人和运动部件被屏障隔开，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A barrier separates a person icon from moving parts, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，提供物理屏障。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上齿轮、防护罩、锁图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with icons of a gear, a protective cover and a padlock.
shots.narration: 运动部件会挤压、夹入、飞出。

shots.scene: 四类防护图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fixed cover, an interlocked door, an adjustable cover and a self-adjusting cover. No people.
shots.narration: 防护装置四类，警示带不算。

shots.scene: 固定罩和锁图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a bolted cover and a lockout padlock with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 要牢、要全、无新危害，拆罩先上锁。

shots.scene: 缺失的防护罩图标亮红
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a machine with its guard missing glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 事故主因是防护缺失或损坏。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别，身后风机装好了皮带罩
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a fan with its belt cover back in place.
shots.narration: 罩子装回去，下次见！
